label: EnGenius ECS1552FP (48x 1G PoE+, 740 W, 4x SFP+)
description: EnGenius Cloud ECS1552FP layer 2+ PoE switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T 802.3af/at PoE+ RJ45 (740 W budget), 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 176 Gbps switching capacity, 32K MAC, 19-inch 1U.

poe.note: 740 W across ports 1-48 at 802.3af/at. 740 W is exactly 48 x 15.4 W (the 802.3af ceiling), not 48 x 30 W (1440 W): the full PoE+ rate is available on 24 ports at once. Full-load input power 885 W, so the supply is sized for the budget plus the switch itself.

fabric.note: Vendor figure 176 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of 48x 1G plus 4x 10G. Packet forwarding rate 130.95 Mpps.

notes: Product page: 48x Gigabit PoE+ ports (1-48, 802.3af/at) with a 740 W budget, 4x 10G SFP+, 176 Gbps, 32K MAC, 2 MB packet buffer, 440 x 310 x 44 mm, 4.76 kg, 19-inch 1U, 885 W full load. Adds PoE Extended Mode (250 m), PD Lifeguard and Continuous PoE. Management is EnGenius Cloud (zero-touch provisioning), the local web GUI (HTTP/HTTPS over IPv4 and IPv6) and a CLI reached over SSH/Telnet/TFTP config backup; SNMP v1/v2c/v3 with RMON 1,2,3,9 is supported. Layer 3 is static routing only: 63 IPv4 and 21 IPv6 static routes, a 192-entry ARP table and up to 20 IPv6 addresses on the box - no OSPF and no BGP, which is why this is modelled as l3-forward without a routing engine. L2 set: 802.1D/w/s spanning tree, 802.1Q tagging with port-based and protocol-based VLANs, 802.3ad link aggregation, IGMP and MLD snooping, voice VLAN, 802.1X with RADIUS, MAC/IP ACLs and storm control, 8 QoS queues. Operating 0-50 C, 5-95% RH non-condensing, 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz, 2-year warranty. Firmware: the ECS15XX-25XX image is shared across the ECS15xx and ECS25xx classes - the download table on the model pages lists ECS15XX-25XX_firmware_1.2.136-197.imag dated 16 July 2026 as the current build, with 1.2.130-193 (27 May 2026) and 1.2.125-192 (12 February 2026) beneath it. Sources: https://www.engeniustech.com/eu/products/network-switches/ecs1552fp/ (specifications, comparison table, 885 W full load) and https://www.engeniustech.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/Cloud-Switches-DS-09-29-20.pdf.
